scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @boardroom/server" "npm run dev -w @boardroom/client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w @boardroom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @boardroom/server && npm run build -w @boardroom/client
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @boardroom/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @boardroom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @boardroom/server && npm run typecheck -w @boardroom/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @boardroom/shared && npm run test -w @boardroom/server
